title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs site quickstarts
author: Asha Menon
description:
Motivation: provide first-class RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) developer artifacts — templates, agents that demonstrate tool-calling patterns, and quickstart pages in the docs site so teams can onboard to RAG + agents faster. This PR adds a set of opinionated templates, runnable examples (Python + TS), and docs site quickstarts with runnable snippets and guided next-steps.

What changed (high level): added new directory examples/rag-agents with three sample agents (faq-bot, sales-assistant, and devops-runbook) that demonstrate tool-calling, structured output, and KV caching; added docs site pages under docs/guides/rag and docs/quickstarts/agents with step-by-step onboarding and code snippets; added markdown templates for customers to copy into their repos; updated the examples README and the docs navigation.

Checklist: [x] examples implemented and unit-tested; [x] docs pages added and linked in site nav; [x] CI checks green after rerun; [x] reviewers addressed comments and edge-cases (tool auth, model selection).

Migration/compatibility notes: examples use the existing SDK surface and a small shim for tool registration — no breaking API changes. Consumers should update example-config to point to their secret store for tool credentials.

References: ENG-5112 for feature work, PM-1287 for product prioritization, SUP-233 for customer ask.

All requested changes were addressed and reviewers approved.
